module Sales
  class CustomersController < ApplicationController
    include ExceptionHandler
    include GaTrackable

    before_action :authenticate_portal_user!
    before_action :authorize_sales
    before_action :set_order, only: [ :customer_stage, :customer_stage_submit ]
    before_action -> { check_form_stage(:customer_stage) }, only: [ :customer_stage, :customer_stage_submit ]
    before_action :set_customer, only: [ :show, :edit, :update ]

    # GET /portal/sales/customers
    def index
       # Get only customers created by the current sales user using association
       @customers = current_portal_user.sales_customers.filter_and_sort(
        query: params[:q],
        sort_column: params[:sort],
        sort_direction: params[:direction],
        page: params[:page]
      )
    end

    # GET /portal/sales/customers/:id
    def show
      # Find the customer - this should happen after set_customer before_action
      # If we made it this far, @customer should be set and authorized
      @user_profile = @customer.ide_user.user_profile
    end

    def edit
      @user_profile = @customer.ide_user.user_profile
    end

    def update
      flash[:form_data] = customer_update_params.to_h
      update_verification_flag = customer_update_params[:update_verification].to_s == "1" # flag for fixing rejected customer data
      order = @customer.orders.find(customer_update_params[:order_id]) if customer_update_params[:order_id].present?

      # Validate required fields before processing
      required_fields = [
        :customer_name, :customer_no_handphone, :company_name,
        :receiver_name, :receiver_no_handphone, :receiver_email
      ]

      missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| customer_update_params[field].blank? }

      if missing_fields.any?
        flash[:error] = "Required fields missing: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
        redirect_to edit_portal_sales_customer_path(@customer)
        return
      end

      # Update IDE User attributes
      ide_user = @customer.ide_user
      ide_user.assign_attributes(
        fullname: customer_update_params[:customer_name]&.strip,
        contactno: customer_update_params[:customer_no_handphone]&.strip
      )

      # Update User Profile attributes
      user_profile = ide_user.user_profile
      user_profile.assign_attributes(
        name: customer_update_params[:customer_name]&.strip,
        phone_number: customer_update_params[:customer_no_handphone]&.strip,
        province_id: customer_update_params[:customer_province],
        city_id: customer_update_params[:customer_city],
        district_id: customer_update_params[:customer_district],
        sub_district_id: customer_update_params[:customer_subdistrict],
        postal_code: get_customer_postal_code(customer_update_params)&.strip,
        address: customer_update_params[:customer_address]&.strip,
        birth_date: customer_update_params[:customer_birthdate],
        birth_place: customer_update_params[:customer_birth_place]&.strip
      )

      # Encrypt sensitive data before saving - only if values provided
      if customer_update_params[:customer_nik].present?
        user_profile.encrypted_nik = StringEncryption.encrypt(customer_update_params[:customer_nik].strip)
      end

      if customer_update_params[:customer_npwp].present?
        user_profile.encrypted_npwp = StringEncryption.encrypt(customer_update_params[:customer_npwp].strip)
      end

      if customer_update_params[:customer_no_kk].present?
        user_profile.encrypted_no_kk = StringEncryption.encrypt(customer_update_params[:customer_no_kk].strip)
      end

      # Update Customer attributes with sanitized values
      @customer.assign_attributes(
        company_name: customer_update_params[:company_name]&.strip,
        receiver_name: customer_update_params[:receiver_name]&.strip,
        receiver_contact_number: customer_update_params[:receiver_no_handphone]&.strip,
        receiver_email: customer_update_params[:receiver_email]&.strip,
        receiver_province_id: customer_update_params[:receiver_province],
        receiver_city_id: customer_update_params[:receiver_city],
        receiver_district_id: customer_update_params[:receiver_district],
        receiver_subdistrict_id: customer_update_params[:receiver_subdistrict],
        receiver_postal_code: get_receiver_postal_code(customer_update_params)&.strip,
        receiver_address: customer_update_params[:receiver_address]&.strip,
        billing_account: :account # Always use account billing for sales
      )

      # Validate all models before saving
      unless ide_user.valid? && user_profile.valid? && @customer.valid?
        flash[:error] = "Validation failed: #{ide_user.errors.full_messages.join(', ')} | #{user_profile.errors.full_messages.join(', ')} | #{@customer.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
        redirect_to edit_portal_sales_customer_path(@customer) and return
      end

      # Attempt to save all records in a transaction
      begin
        Customer.transaction do
          # Validate all models before saving
          raise ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid unless ide_user.valid? && user_profile.valid? && @customer.valid?

          ide_user.save!
          user_profile.save!
          @customer.save!

          # update flag for verification fiex by sales
          if update_verification_flag && order.present? && order.customer_approval_rejected?
            order.update!(customer_data_approval: :pending)
            VerificatorMailer.customer_data_recheck(order).deliver_later
          end

          # Log customer update
          Rails.logger.info("Customer #{@customer.id} updated by #{current_portal_user.email}: #{@customer.previous_changes}")
        end

        redirect_to portal_sales_customer_path(@customer), notice: "Customer was successfully updated."
      rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
        # Collect validation errors from all models
        field_errors = {}

        ide_user.errors.messages.each do |field, messages|
          field_errors["customer_#{field}"] = messages
        end

        user_profile.errors.messages.each do |field, messages|
          field_errors["customer_#{field}"] = messages
        end

        @customer.errors.messages.each do |field, messages|
          field_errors[field] = messages
        end

        # Store errors in flash for display
        flash[:field_errors] = field_errors

        # Build detailed error message
        error_details = []
        error_details << "IDE User: #{ide_user.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}" if ide_user.errors.any?
        error_details << "Profile: #{user_profile.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}" if user_profile.errors.any?
        error_details << "Customer: #{@customer.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}" if @customer.errors.any?

        flash[:error] = "Failed to update customer: #{error_details.join(' | ')}"

        redirect_to edit_portal_sales_customer_path(@customer)
      rescue StandardError => e
        Rails.logger.error("Error updating customer: #{e.message}")
        flash[:error] = "An unexpected error occurred"
        redirect_to edit_portal_sales_customer_path(@customer)
      end
    end

    def customer_stage
      # Track order creation (moved from create action due to redirect)
      if session.delete(:track_order_creation) # Only track once
        track_sales_action("click_order_now",
                           order: @order,
                           product_name: @order&.order_items&.first&.product&.name,
                           custom_params: {
                             product_name: @order&.order_items&.first&.product&.name,
                             total_msisdns: @order&.order_items&.first&.item_quantity,
                             customer_type: session.delete(:customer_type), # Get from session
                             next_page_url: customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order)
                           })
      end
    end

    def customer_stage_submit
      begin
        flash[:form_data] = customer_params.to_h.merge(receiver_params.to_h) # form data to be sent back to the form

        # > check if email exists on ide user (using sso validate api)
        if IdeUser.valid_email_exists?(customer_params[:customer_email])
          Rails.logger.info "User exists: #{customer_params[:customer_email]}"
          redirect_to customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "User is already registered"
          return
        end

        # only force nik check on prod (temp)
        if ENV["FEATURE_FLAG_NIK_CHECKING"].downcase == "true"
          # > check nik
          dukcapil_service = Surrounding::DukcapilFullCheckService.new(
            name: dukcapil_params[:receiver_name],
            phone_number: dukcapil_params[:receiver_no_handphone],
            birthdate: dukcapil_params[:customer_birthdate],
            nik: dukcapil_params[:customer_nik],
            no_kk: dukcapil_params[:customer_no_kk],
            msisdn: dukcapil_params[:receiver_no_handphone]
          )
          response = dukcapil_service.call

          unless response[:success]
            Rails.logger.info "NIK validation failed: #{response[:error]}"
            redirect_to customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: response[:error][0]
            return
          end
        end

        # > create password
        password = PasswordGenerator.generate

        # > validate regular user without saving
        regular_user = PortalUser.new(
          name: customer_params[:customer_name],
          email: customer_params[:customer_email],
          password: password,
          password_confirmation: password,
          verified: 0 # verify using first login link
        )

        unless regular_user.valid?
          Rails.logger.error "Regular User Validation Failed: #{regular_user.errors.full_messages}"
          redirect_to customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Regular user validation failed: #{regular_user.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
          return
        end

        # > validate customer without saving
        customer = Customer.new(
          sales: current_portal_user,
          regular_user: regular_user,
          receiver_name: receiver_params[:receiver_name],
          receiver_contact_number: receiver_params[:receiver_no_handphone],
          receiver_email: receiver_params[:receiver_email],
          receiver_province_id: receiver_params[:receiver_province],
          receiver_city_id: receiver_params[:receiver_city],
          receiver_district_id: receiver_params[:receiver_district],
          receiver_subdistrict_id: receiver_params[:receiver_subdistrict],
          receiver_address: receiver_params[:receiver_address],
          receiver_postal_code: get_receiver_postal_code(receiver_params),
          company_name: customer_params[:customer_company_name],
          billing_account: :account # Always use account billing for sales
        )

        unless customer.valid?
          Rails.logger.error "Customer Validation Failed: #{customer.errors.full_messages}"
          redirect_to customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Customer validation failed: #{customer.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
          return
        end

        ide_user_id = 0
        unless Rails.env.development?
          # > register user using sso register api
          ide_user_id = register_user_with_sso!(customer, customer_params, password)
          return if performed?
        else
          ide_user = register_to_local_user(customer_params, password)
          ide_user_id = ide_user.id
          return if performed?
        end

        # > update customer id
        customer.ide_user_id = ide_user_id

        # > CREATE REGULAR USER (PORTAL USER)
        regular_user.add_role(:user)
        regular_user.save!

        # > save customer
        if customer.save
          Rails.logger.info "Customer Created: #{customer.inspect}"

          # update order customer FK
          @order.customer = customer
          @order.location = current_portal_user.location
          @order.regular_user = regular_user
          @order.form_stage = :msisdn_stage
          @order.save!

          # > send registration notification email
          regular_user.generate_login_token!(14.days)
          OrderRegistrationMailer.first_login_email_from_order(email: regular_user.email, login_token: regular_user.login_token).deliver_later

          # Store tracking data in session for the next page (due to redirect)
          session[:track_select_msisdn] = true

          # ! TODO: redirect to next step
          redirect_to msisdn_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "Customer successfully created"
          nil
        else
          Rails.logger.error "Customer Creation Failed: #{customer.errors}"
          redirect_to customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Customer creation failed: #{customer.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
          nil
        end
      end # begin
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.error("Exception in customer_stage_submit: #{e.class} - #{e.message}\n#{e.backtrace.join("\n")}")
      flash[:alert] = "An unexpected error occurred. Please try again."
      redirect_to customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order)
      nil
    end

    private
      def set_order
        @order = Order.find(params[:id])
        if @order.nil?
          redirect_to portal_sales_dashboard_path, alert: "Order not found"
        end
      end

      def dukcapil_params
        params.permit(:receiver_name, :receiver_no_handphone, :customer_nik, :customer_no_kk, :customer_birthdate)
      end

      def customer_params
        params.permit(
          :customer_name, :customer_no_handphone, :customer_email, :customer_company_name, :customer_province,
          :customer_city, :customer_subdistrict, :customer_district, :customer_postal_code, :customer_postal_code_manual, :customer_address, :customer_nik,
          :customer_no_kk, :customer_birth_place, :customer_birthdate, :customer_npwp, :informed_about_ide,
          :customer_info_confirmed)
      end

      def receiver_params
        params.permit(
          :receiver_name, :receiver_no_handphone, :receiver_email, :receiver_province, :receiver_city,
          :receiver_district, :receiver_subdistrict, :receiver_postal_code, :receiver_postal_code_manual, :receiver_address)
      end

      def customer_update_params
        # Get customer params from the customer hash
        customer_params = params.require(:customer).permit(
          :customer_name, :customer_no_handphone, :customer_nik, :customer_npwp,
          :customer_no_kk, :customer_postal_code, :customer_postal_code_manual, :customer_address, :customer_birthdate,
          :customer_birth_place, :company_name, :customer_province, :customer_city,
          :customer_district, :customer_subdistrict,
          # Receiver params
          :receiver_name, :receiver_no_handphone, :receiver_email, :receiver_province,
          :receiver_city, :receiver_district, :receiver_subdistrict, :receiver_postal_code, :receiver_postal_code_manual,
          :receiver_address
        )

        location_params = params.permit(
          :customer_province, :customer_city, :customer_district, :customer_subdistrict, :customer_postal_code, :customer_postal_code_manual,
          :receiver_province, :receiver_city, :receiver_district, :receiver_subdistrict, :receiver_postal_code, :receiver_postal_code_manual,
        )

        # for verification fixes by sales
        verification_params = params.permit(:update_verification, :order_id)

        # Merge location params into customer params
        customer_params.merge(location_params).merge(verification_params)
      end

      def map_sso_field_to_form_field(sso_field)
        mapping = {
          "email" => "customer_email",
          "password" => "password",
          "name" => "customer_name",
          "phone_number" => "customer_no_handphone",
          "province" => "customer_province",
          "city" => "customer_city",
          "district" => "customer_district",
          "address" => "customer_address",
          "postal_code" => "customer_postal_code",
          "birth_date" => "customer_birthdate",
          "nik" => "customer_nik",
          "no_kk" => "customer_no_kk"
        }

        mapping[sso_field] || sso_field
      end

      def set_customer
        # FIND customer by id (without any scope restriction)
        customer = Customer.find_by(id: params[:id])

        # IF customer not found OR customer doesn't belong to current sales user
        # THEN redirect with "Not authorized" message
        if customer.nil? || customer.sales_id != current_portal_user.id
          redirect_to portal_sales_customers_path, alert: "Not authorized"
          return
        end

        # ELSE customer is valid and authorized
        # SET @customer for use in controller actions
        @customer = customer
      end

      def register_user_with_sso!(customer, customer_params, password)
        # ! create service to isolate sso + customer registration logic
        # ! use auth0 token cache for sso token
        token_service = Http::Auth0::AccessTokenService.new(
          client_id: ENV["AUTH0_PHOENIX_CLIENT_ID"],
          client_secret: ENV["AUTH0_PHOENIX_CLIENT_SECRET"],
          audience: ENV["AUTH0_SSO_SERVICE_AUDIENCE"])
        token_service.call

        unless token_service.success?
          Rails.logger.info "Failed to get auth0 token: #{token_service.response_body.inspect}"
          redirect_to customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to get auth0 token"
          return
        end

        bearer_token = token_service.response_body["access_token"]

        register_params = {
          email: customer_params[:customer_email],
          password: password,
          birth_date: customer_params[:customer_birthdate],
          name: customer_params[:customer_name],
          phone_number: customer_params[:customer_no_handphone],
          province: customer_params[:customer_province],
          city: customer_params[:customer_city],
          district: customer_params[:customer_district],
          address: customer_params[:customer_address],
          postal_code: get_customer_postal_code(customer_params),
          business_name: customer_params[:customer_company_name],
          source: "bulk:#{current_portal_user.email}",
          nik: customer_params[:customer_nik],
          no_kk: customer_params[:customer_no_kk],
          birth_place: customer_params[:customer_birth_place],
          npwp: customer_params[:customer_npwp],
          province_id: customer_params[:customer_province],
          city_id: customer_params[:customer_city],
          district_id: customer_params[:customer_district],
          sub_district_id: customer_params[:customer_subdistrict]
        }

        sso_user_registration_service = Http::Sso::UserRegistrationService.new(bearer_token: bearer_token, register_params: register_params)
        sso_user_registration_service.call

        unless sso_user_registration_service.success?
          response = sso_user_registration_service.response_body
          message = response["message"] || "Registration failed"
          @registration_errors = {}

          if response["data"].is_a?(Hash)
            response["data"].each do |field, messages|
              form_field = map_sso_field_to_form_field(field)
              @registration_errors[form_field] = messages
            end
          end

          detailed_errors = response["data"].present? ? response["data"].map { |key, value| "#{key} #{value.join(', ')}" }.join(". ") : ""
          @error_message = "#{message}. #{detailed_errors}".strip

          flash[:error] = @error_message # generalized error message
          flash[:field_errors] = @registration_errors # specific field errors

          @order = Order.find(params[:id])
          redirect_to customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order)
          return
        end

        sso_user_registration_service.response_body["data"]["id"]
      end

      def get_customer_postal_code(params)
        # Use manual postal code if present, otherwise use dropdown selection
        if params[:customer_postal_code_manual].present?
          params[:customer_postal_code_manual]
        else
          params[:customer_postal_code]
        end
      end

      def get_receiver_postal_code(params)
        # Use manual postal code if present, otherwise use dropdown selection
        if params[:receiver_postal_code_manual].present?
          params[:receiver_postal_code_manual]
        else
          params[:receiver_postal_code]
        end
      end

    def register_to_local_user(customer_params, password)
      begin
        ide_user = IdeUser.create!(
          id: SecureRandom.uuid,
          fullname: customer_params[:customer_name],
          email: customer_params[:customer_email],
          contactno: customer_params[:customer_no_handphone],
          countrycode: "+62",
          password: password,
          iscompleted: 1
        )
        UserProfile.create!(
          user_id: ide_user.id,
          name: customer_params[:customer_name],
          phone_number: customer_params[:customer_no_handphone],
          birth_place: customer_params[:customer_birth_place],
          birth_date: customer_params[:customer_birthdate],
          country: "Indonesia",
          business_name: customer_params[:customer_company_name],
          province: Province.find_by(code: customer_params[:customer_province]),
          city: Regency.find_by(code: customer_params[:customer_city]),
          district: District.find_by(code: customer_params[:customer_district]),
          subdistrict: Village.find_by(code: customer_params[:customer_subdistrict]),
          postal_code: get_customer_postal_code(customer_params),
          address: customer_params[:customer_address],
          encrypted_nik: StringEncryption.encrypt(customer_params[:customer_nik]),
          encrypted_no_kk: StringEncryption.encrypt(customer_params[:customer_no_kk]),
          encrypted_npwp: StringEncryption.encrypt(customer_params[:customer_npwp]),
          created_at: Time.current,
          updated_at: Time.current
        )
        ide_user
      rescue => e
        Rails.logger.error("Exception in register_to_local_user: #{e.class} - #{e.message}\n#{e.backtrace.join("\n")}")
        flash[:alert] = "Failed to create user profile: #{e.message}"
        redirect_to customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to create user profile"
        nil
      end
    end
  end
end

   146→  # cancel order
   147→  def cancel_order!(cancel_reason: nil, current_user: nil)
   148→    # Prevent double cancellation - idempotent operation
   149→    return false if cancelled?
   150→    transaction do
   151→      # > check if any postpaid activations are already activated
   152→      if postpaid_activations.exists? && postpaid_activations.where(status: :activated).exists?
   153→        raise StandardError, "Cannot cancel order with activated postpaid activations"
   154→      end
   155→
   156→      # > change status to cancelled
   157→      update!(
   158→        status: :cancelled,
   159→        cancel_reason: cancel_reason,
   160→        updated_at: Time.current
   161→      )
   162→
   163→      if postpaid_activations.exists?
   164→        # > release reserved msisdns and iccids, cleanup postpaid activations
   165→        release_reserved_msisdns_and_iccids!
   166→      end
   167→
   168→      # Create audit record if current_user is provided
   169→      if current_user.present?
   170→        audit_verificator_action!(
   171→          "cancel_order",
   172→          current_user,
   173→          { reason: cancel_reason }
   174→        )
   175→      end
   176→
   177→      Rails.logger.info "Order ##{id} cancelled successfully.#{cancel_reason.present? ? " Reason: #{cancel_reason}" : ''}"
   178→    end
   179→
   180→    true
   181→  end

   183→  # msisdn methods
   184→  def release_reserved_msisdns_and_iccids!
   185→    return 0 unless postpaid_activations.any?
   186→
   187→    released_count = 0
   188→    updated_msisdn_count = 0
   189→    updated_iccid_count = 0
   190→
   191→    transaction do
   192→      # Get MSISDN and ICCID IDs before deletion
   193→      msisdn_ids = order_items.joins(:postpaid_activations)
   194→                             .pluck("postpaid_activations.msisdn_id").compact
   195→
   196→      iccid_ids = order_items.joins(:postpaid_activations)
   197→                            .where.not(postpaid_activations: { iccid_id: nil })
   198→                            .pluck("postpaid_activations.iccid_id").compact
   199→
   200→      if msisdn_ids.any?
   201→        # > update msisdns status back to available
   202→        updated_msisdn_count = Msisdn.where(id: msisdn_ids)
   203→                                    .where(status: :reserved)
   204→                                    .update_all(status: :available, updated_at: Time.current)
   205→
   206→        released_count += updated_msisdn_count
   207→      end
   208→
   209→      if iccid_ids.any?
   210→        # > update iccid status back to available
   211→        updated_iccid_count = Iccid.where(id: iccid_ids)
   212→                                   .where(status: :reserved)
   213→                                   .update_all(status: :available, updated_at: Time.current)
   214→      end
   215→
   216→      # Delete the postpaid activations as part of cleanup
   217→      activations = PostpaidActivation.joins(:order_item).where(order_items: { order_id: id })
   218→      activations_count = activations.count
   219→      deleted_count = activations.delete_all
   220→
   221→      if deleted_count != activations_count
   222→        raise PostpaidActivationsReleaseError, "Failed to delete all postpaid activations: only #{deleted_count} of #{activations_count} were deleted"
   223→      end
   224→
   225→      Rails.logger.info("Released #{updated_msisdn_count} MSISDNs and #{updated_iccid_count} ICCIDs, deleted #{deleted_count} postpaid activations for order #{id}")
   226→    end
   227→
   228→    released_count
   229→  end

class Order < ApplicationRecord
  audited associated_with: :verified_by, only: [ :verified_by_id, :customer_data_approval ], comment_required: false

  # Audit verificator actions
  def self.audit_verificator_action(action_type, user, order, details = {})
    # Create a custom audit record with verificator context
    Audited::Audit.create!(
      auditable: order,
      user: user,
      action: "verificator_action",
      audited_changes: {},
      comment: {
        action_type: action_type,
        details: details,
        user_name: user.name,
        user_role: user.roles.first&.name
      }.to_json
    )
  end

  belongs_to :sales, class_name: "PortalUser", foreign_key: "sales_id"
  belongs_to :regular_user, class_name: "PortalUser", foreign_key: "regular_user_id", optional: true
  belongs_to :location, optional: true
  belongs_to :customer, optional: true
  belongs_to :verified_by, class_name: "PortalUser", optional: true

  before_create :build_order_reference_number

  # Active Storage attachment
  # lookup from document_approval.rb
  DocumentApproval::DOCUMENT_TYPES.each do |document_type|
    has_one_attached document_type.underscore.to_sym
  end
  has_one_attached :fab
  has_one_attached :delivery_proof

  # Add association with order items
  has_many :order_items, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :payments, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :postpaid_activations, through: :order_items

  # Document approvals
  has_many :document_approvals, dependent: :destroy


  # Get verificator audit timeline using Audited
  def verificator_audit_timeline
    audits.where(action: [ "update", "verificator_action" ])
          .includes(:user)  # Eager load user untuk avoid N+1 queries
          .order(created_at: :desc)  # Latest first (terbaru dulu)
          .limit(15)  # Limit to 15 latest records untuk performance
  end

  def audit_verificator_action!(action_type, user, details = {})
    Order.audit_verificator_action(action_type, user, self, details)
  end

  delegate :name, to: :sales, prefix: true
  delegate :id, to: :sales, prefix: true, allow_nil: true
  delegate :name, to: :regular_user, prefix: true, allow_nil: true
  delegate :name, to: :location, prefix: true, allow_nil: true
  delegate :name, to: :regular_user, prefix: true, allow_nil: true
  delegate :email, to: :regular_user, prefix: true, allow_nil: true
  delegate :code, to: :location, prefix: true, allow_nil: true
  delegate :receiver_name, to: :customer, prefix: true, allow_nil: true

  enum :tax, { include: 1, exclude: 0 }
  enum :status, {
    draft: 0,          # isi data pengajuan, iccid & msisdn, Role: sales
    verification: 1,   # customer upload, verification by verificator, Role: Customer, Verificator, Sales
    payment: 2,        # waiting payment, payment process, inventory sync, Role: Customer, Sales
    delivery: 3,       # prepare delivery, warehouse, pick up, delivery process, Role: Sales, Service Delivery
    activation: 4,     # activation and make sure customer using it, Role: Customer, Sales, CS
    complete: 5,       # done
    cancelled: 6       # all cancel status and put back MSISDN to Available
  }
  enum :customer_data_approval, { rejected: 0, approved: 1, pending: 2 }, prefix: :customer_approval
  enum :document_upload_by, { customer: 0, sales: 1 }, prefix: :document_upload_by

  validates :total_price, :delivery_price, :tax, :status, presence: true

  # Validate delivery proof is an image and maximum 10MB
  validate :validate_delivery_proof, if: -> { delivery_proof.attached? }

  # Validate e-FAB document
  validate :validate_fab, if: -> { fab.attached? }

  validates :total_price, :delivery_price, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }
  validates :tax_price, :discount_price, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }, allow_nil: true

  # rendering utility
  enum :form_stage, {
    customer_stage: "customer_stage",
    msisdn_stage: "msisdn_stage",
    verification_stage: "verification_stage",
    payment_stage: "payment_stage",
    delivery_stage: "delivery_stage",
    activation_stage: "activation_stage"
  }
  # Define valid order stages based on role
  VALID_ORDER_STAGES = {
    sales: form_stages.keys,
    customers: %w[verification_stage payment_stage delivery_stage activation_stage]
  }.freeze

  # Define payment_status enum with database-backed column
  # TODO: will use database table in the future
  enum :payment_status, { pending: 0, complete: 1 }, prefix: true
  after_initialize :set_default_payment_status, if: :new_record?

  # Validations
  validates :sales_id, presence: true
  validates :total_price, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }
  validates :delivery_price, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }
  validates :tax, presence: true
  validates :status, presence: true
  validates :tax_price, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }, allow_nil: true
  validates :discount_price, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }, allow_nil: true

  # Callbacks
  before_create :set_default_status
  after_save :create_pending_document_approvals, if: :saved_change_to_status?

  # Konstanta tambahan
  DOCUMENT_TYPES = DocumentApproval::DOCUMENT_TYPES.map(&:underscore).freeze

  # Scope to exclude customer stage orders
  scope :exclude_customer_stage, -> { where.not(form_stage: :customer_stage) }
  scope :verification_payment_or_cancelled, -> {
    where(form_stage: [ :verification_stage, :payment_stage ])
    .or(where(status: :cancelled))
  }

  # Reorder method
  def reorder!
    transaction do
      update!(
        form_stage: :msisdn_stage,
        status: :draft,
        verification_expired_at: nil,
        payment_expired_at: nil
      )
    end
  end

  # cancel order
  def cancel_order!(cancel_reason: nil, current_user: nil)
    # Prevent double cancellation - idempotent operation
    return false if cancelled?
    transaction do
      # > check if any postpaid activations are already activated
      if postpaid_activations.exists? && postpaid_activations.where(status: :activated).exists?
        raise StandardError, "Cannot cancel order with activated postpaid activations"
      end

      # > change status to cancelled
      update!(
        status: :cancelled,
        cancel_reason: cancel_reason,
        updated_at: Time.current
      )

      if postpaid_activations.exists?
        # > release reserved msisdns and iccids, cleanup postpaid activations
        release_reserved_msisdns_and_iccids!
      end

      # Create audit record if current_user is provided
      if current_user.present?
        audit_verificator_action!(
          "cancel_order",
          current_user,
          { reason: cancel_reason }
        )
      end

      Rails.logger.info "Order ##{id} cancelled successfully.#{cancel_reason.present? ? " Reason: #{cancel_reason}" : ''}"
    end

    true
  end

  # msisdn methods
  def release_reserved_msisdns_and_iccids!
    return 0 unless postpaid_activations.any?

    released_count = 0
    updated_msisdn_count = 0
    updated_iccid_count = 0

    transaction do
      # Get MSISDN and ICCID IDs before deletion
      msisdn_ids = order_items.joins(:postpaid_activations)
                             .pluck("postpaid_activations.msisdn_id").compact

      iccid_ids = order_items.joins(:postpaid_activations)
                            .where.not(postpaid_activations: { iccid_id: nil })
                            .pluck("postpaid_activations.iccid_id").compact

      if msisdn_ids.any?
        # > update msisdns status back to available
        updated_msisdn_count = Msisdn.where(id: msisdn_ids)
                                    .where(status: :reserved)
                                    .update_all(status: :available, updated_at: Time.current)

        released_count += updated_msisdn_count
      end

      if iccid_ids.any?
        # > update iccid status back to available
        updated_iccid_count = Iccid.where(id: iccid_ids)
                                   .where(status: :reserved)
                                   .update_all(status: :available, updated_at: Time.current)
      end

      # Delete the postpaid activations as part of cleanup
      activations = PostpaidActivation.joins(:order_item).where(order_items: { order_id: id })
      activations_count = activations.count
      deleted_count = activations.delete_all

      if deleted_count != activations_count
        raise PostpaidActivationsReleaseError, "Failed to delete all postpaid activations: only #{deleted_count} of #{activations_count} were deleted"
      end

      Rails.logger.info("Released #{updated_msisdn_count} MSISDNs and #{updated_iccid_count} ICCIDs, deleted #{deleted_count} postpaid activations for order #{id}")
    end

    released_count
  end

  # pricing methods
  def total_price_with_vat
    total_price + (tax == "exclude" ? tax_price : 0)
  end

  def security_deposit_with_vat
    security_deposit + security_deposit * 11/100
  end

  # delivery methods
  def delivered?
    delivery_proof.attached?
  end

  # payment methods
  def success_payment
    payments.where(status: :paid)&.first
  end

  # document validation methods
  def valid_document?(document)
    return false unless document.present?

    content_type = document.content_type
    size = document.size

    Rails.logger.info "Validating document - Content Type: #{content_type}, Size: #{size}"

    valid_types = [ "application/pdf", "image/jpeg", "image/jpg" ]
    max_size = 10.megabytes

    valid_types.include?(content_type) && size <= max_size
  end

  # Document approval methods
  def document_status(document_type)
    approval = document_approvals.find_by(document_type: document_type)
    approval&.status || "pending"
  end

  def document_approved?(document_type)
    document_status(document_type) == "approved"
  end

  def document_rejected?(document_type)
    document_status(document_type) == "rejected"
  end

  def document_pending?(document_type)
    document_status(document_type) == "pending"
  end

  def document_rejection_note(document_type)
    approval = document_approvals.find_by(document_type: document_type)
    approval&.note
  end

  def approve_document(document_type, reviewer)
    previous_verificator = verified_by

    approval = document_approvals.find_or_initialize_by(document_type: document_type)
    approval.status = :approved
    approval.reviewed_by = reviewer
    approval.note = nil
    approval.save
    update(verified_by: reviewer)

    # Create audit record using Audited
    audit_verificator_action!(
      "approve_document",
      reviewer,
      {
        document_type: document_type,
        previous_verificator: previous_verificator&.name
      }
    )
  end

  def reject_document(document_type, reviewer, note)
    previous_verificator = verified_by

    approval = document_approvals.find_or_initialize_by(document_type: document_type)
    approval.status = :rejected
    approval.reviewed_by = reviewer
    approval.note = note
    approval.save
    update(verified_by: reviewer)

    # Create audit record using Audited
    audit_verificator_action!(
      "reject_document",
      reviewer,
      {
        document_type: document_type,
        note: note,
        previous_verificator: previous_verificator&.name
      }
    )
  end

  def all_documents_approved?
    all_required_documents_approved?
    public_send(:power_of_attorney).attached? && document_approvals.exists?(document_type: :power_of_attorney, status: :approved)
    public_send(:account_statement).attached? && document_approvals.exists?(document_type: :account_statement, status: :approved)
    public_send(:ktp_pic).attached? && document_approvals.exists?(document_type: :ktp_pic, status: :approved)
  end

  def all_document_approved_and_optional_document_uploaded?
    all_required_documents_approved? &&
    (power_of_attorney.attached? ? document_approved?(:power_of_attorney) : true) &&
    (account_statement.attached? ? document_approved?(:account_statement) : true) &&
    (ktp_pic.attached? ? document_approved?(:ktp_pic) : true)
  end

  def all_required_documents_approved?
    public_send(:akta).attached? && document_approvals.exists?(document_type: :akta, status: :approved) &&
    public_send(:npwp).attached? && document_approvals.exists?(document_type: :npwp, status: :approved) &&
    public_send(:nib).attached? && document_approvals.exists?(document_type: :nib, status: :approved) &&
    public_send(:ktp_owner).attached? && document_approvals.exists?(document_type: :ktp_owner, status: :approved) &&
    public_send(:mou).attached? && document_approvals.exists?(document_type: :mou, status: :approved)
  end

  def all_required_documents_uploaded?
    public_send(:akta).attached? &&
    public_send(:npwp).attached? &&
    public_send(:nib).attached? &&
    public_send(:ktp_owner).attached?
  end

  def has_rejected_documents?
    document_approvals.rejected.exists?
  end

  def has_rejected_required_documents?
    # akta, npwp, nib, ktp_owner
    document_approvals.rejected.exists?(document_type: :akta) ||
    document_approvals.rejected.exists?(document_type: :npwp) ||
    document_approvals.rejected.exists?(document_type: :nib) ||
    document_approvals.rejected.exists?(document_type: :ktp_owner)
  end

  # Consent approval methods
  REQUIRED_CONSENT_ITEMS = %w[
    document_upload_permission
    document_accuracy_responsibility
    data_processing_consent
    terms_conditions_agreement
  ].freeze

  def validate_consent_items(consent_items)
    consent_items = Array(consent_items)
    missing_consents = REQUIRED_CONSENT_ITEMS - consent_items

    if missing_consents.any?
      return {
        valid: false,
        message: "All consent items must be checked to proceed.",
        missing_items: missing_consents
      }
    end

    { valid: true }
  end

  def approve_consent!(user_id = nil)
    update!(
      document_upload_by: :sales,
      consent_approved_at: Time.current
    )

    ConsentApprovalMailer.consent_approved_notification(self).deliver_later

    Rails.logger.info("Consent approval completed for order ##{id}#{user_id ? " by customer ##{user_id}" : ''}")
    true
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error("Error processing consent approval for order ##{id}: #{e.message}")
    Rails.logger.error(e.backtrace.join("\n"))
    false
  end

  def self.filter_and_sort(query: nil, status: nil, sort_column: nil, sort_direction: "asc", page: 1)
    orders = all
    orders = orders.joins(:regular_user).where("portal_users.name LIKE ? OR orders.order_reference_number LIKE ? OR orders.total_price LIKE ?", "%#{query}%", "%#{query}%", "%#{query}%") if query.present?
    orders = orders.where(status: status) if status.present?
    orders = orders.order("#{sort_column} #{sort_direction}") if sort_column.present?
    orders = orders.order(created_at: :desc) unless sort_column.present?

    orders = orders.includes(
      :sales,
      :location,
      :customer,
      :order_items,
      { order_items: [ :product ] },
      :akta_attachment,
      :npwp_attachment,
      :nib_attachment,
      :ktp_owner_attachment,
      :account_statement_attachment,
      :power_of_attorney_attachment
    )

    orders.page(page).per(10)
  end

  def validate_delivery_proof
    if !delivery_proof.content_type.in?(%w[image/jpeg image/jpg])
      errors.add(:delivery_proof, "must be an image (JPEG, JPG)")
      delivery_proof.purge
    elsif delivery_proof.blob.byte_size > 10.megabytes
      errors.add(:delivery_proof, "is too large (maximum is 10MB)")
      delivery_proof.purge
    end
  end

  def delivery_proof_presence
    errors.add(:delivery_proof, "must be attached") unless delivery_proof.attached?
  end

  def validate_fab
    if !fab.content_type.in?(%w[application/pdf image/jpeg image/jpg])
      errors.add(:fab, "must be a PDF document or image (JPEG, JPG)")
      fab.purge
    elsif fab.blob.byte_size > 10.megabytes
      errors.add(:fab, "is too large (maximum is 10MB)")
      fab.purge
    end
  end

  def fab_presence
    errors.add(:fab, "must be attached") unless fab.attached?
  end

  def has_any_attachments?
    DOCUMENT_TYPES.any? { |doc| send(doc).attached? }
  end

  # Tambahan helper buat show
  def formatted_currency(val)
    return unless val.present?
    "Rp #{ActionController::Base.helpers.number_with_delimiter(val, delimiter: '.')}"
  end

  def first_order_item
    order_items.first
  end

  # Document related methods
  def document_attached?(document_type)
    # Check if the document type is valid and the attachment exists
    return false unless DOCUMENT_TYPES.include?(document_type)
    send(document_type).attached?
  end

  def document_for(document_type)
    # Check if the document type is valid and return the attachment
    return nil unless DOCUMENT_TYPES.include?(document_type)
    send(document_type)
  end

  def receiver_billing?
    customer&.billing_account == "receiver"
  end

  def customer_receiver_contact
    customer&.receiver_contact_number
  end

  def customer_receiver_email
    customer&.receiver_email
  end

  def customer_receiver_address
    customer&.receiver_address
  end

  def customer_receiver_postal_code
    customer&.receiver_postal_code
  end

  def customer_name
    customer&.ide_user&.name
  end

  def customer_phone
    phone = customer&.ide_user&.contactno
    phone ? "+62#{phone}" : nil
  end

  def customer_email
    customer&.ide_user&.email
  end

  def customer_address
    customer&.ide_user&.address || customer&.ide_user&.user_profile&.address
  end

  def customer_nik
    customer&.ide_user&.nik
  end

  def customer_npwp
    customer&.ide_user&.npwp
  end

  def customer_no_kk
    customer&.ide_user&.no_kk
  end

  def customer_birth_place
    customer&.ide_user&.birth_place
  end

  def customer_birth_date
    customer&.ide_user&.birth_date
  end

  def sales_email
    sales&.email
  end

  def customer_receiver_name_or_default
    customer_receiver_name || "-"
  end

  def customer_receiver_contact_or_default
    customer_receiver_contact || "-"
  end

  def customer_receiver_email_or_default
    customer_receiver_email || "-"
  end

  def customer_receiver_address_or_default
    customer_receiver_address || "-"
  end

  def first_order_item_product_name
    order_items.first&.product_name
  end

  def first_order_item_quantity
    order_items.first&.item_quantity
  end

  def last_payment_waiting_or_paid?
    payments.last&.status&.in?([ "waiting", "paid" ])
  end

  def build_order_reference_number
    # the format is IDE-ORD-YYMMDD-INCREMENT_ID
    increment_id = Order.last&.id.to_s.rjust(6, "0").to_i + 1
    self.order_reference_number = "IDE#{Time.current.strftime('%Y%m%d')}#{increment_id}"
  end

  def good_issued_successful?
    return false unless response_good_issued.present?

    parse_json_response || parse_xml_response
  end

  private

  def set_default_status
    self.status ||= :draft
  end

  def set_default_payment_status
    self.payment_status ||= :pending
  end

  def parse_json_response
    return false unless response_good_issued.start_with?("{", "[")

    response_data = JSON.parse(response_good_issued)
    response_data.dig("success") == true
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    false
  end

  def parse_xml_response
    return false unless response_good_issued.include?("<?xml")

    doc = Nokogiri::XML(response_good_issued)
    good_issued_response = doc.at_xpath("//good:GoodIssuedResponse", "good" => "http://esb.indosat.com/IPMS/GoodIssued")
    good_issued_response.present?
  rescue Nokogiri::XML::SyntaxError
    false
  end

  def create_pending_document_approvals
    return unless verification? || complete?

    DOCUMENT_TYPES.each do |doc|
      if send(doc).attached? && !document_approvals.exists?(document_type: doc)
        document_approvals.create(document_type: doc, status: :pending)
      end
    end
  end
end

class OrderItem < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :order
  belongs_to :product
  has_many :postpaid_activations, dependent: :destroy

  accepts_nested_attributes_for :postpaid_activations, allow_destroy: true

  delegate :name, to: :product, prefix: true, allow_nil: true

  # Validations
  validates :price, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }
  validates :discount_price, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }
  validates :tax, presence: true
  validates :tax_price, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }
  validates :item_quantity, presence: true

  # Enum for tax (include/exclude)
  enum :tax, {
    exclude: 0,
    include: 1
  }

  # These methods require both MSISDN and ICCID as PostpaidActivations now require both
  def create_parent_postpaid_activation(msisdn, iccid)
    postpaid_activations.create!(
      msisdn: msisdn,
      iccid: iccid,
      status: :created,
      parent: true
    )
  end

  def create_child_postpaid_activation(msisdn, iccid)
    postpaid_activations.create!(
      msisdn: msisdn,
      iccid: iccid,
      status: :created,
      parent: false
    )
  end

  def create_child_postpaid_activations(msisdns, iccids)
    raise ArgumentError, "MSISDNs and ICCIDs arrays must have the same length" if msisdns.size != iccids.size

    msisdns.zip(iccids).map do |msisdn, iccid|
      create_child_postpaid_activation(msisdn, iccid)
    end
  end

  def postpaid_all_activated?
    postpaid_activations.present? && postpaid_activations.all? { |activation| activation.status == "activated" }
  end

  def parent_postpaid_activation
    postpaid_activations.find_by(parent: true)
  end

  def quantity
    item_quantity
  end

  def per_item_price_with_vat
    price + (tax == "exclude" ? tax_price : 0)
  end

  def total_price_with_vat
    (price + (tax == "exclude" ? tax_price : 0)) * item_quantity
  end
end

class OrderPolicy < ApplicationPolicy
  class Scope < Scope
    def resolve
      if user.has_role?(:admin)
        scope.all
      elsif user.has_role?(:sales)
        scope.where(sales_id: user.id)
      else
        scope.where(regular_user_id: user.id)
      end
    end
  end

  def show?
    user_owns_order? || user_is_admin? || user_is_sales_for_order?
  end

  def update?
    user_owns_order? || user_is_admin? || user_is_sales_for_order?
  end

  private
    def user_owns_order?
      user.present? && record.regular_user_id == user.id
    end

    def user_is_admin?
      user.present? && user.has_role?(:admin)
    end

    def user_is_sales_for_order?
      user.present? && record.sales_id == user.id
  end
end

    end

    it "redirects to login if not authenticated" do
      sign_out sales_portal_user
      get portal_sales_orders_path
      expect(response).to redirect_to(new_portal_user_session_path)
    end

    it "redirects with alert if user does not have sales role" do
      sign_in portal_user
      get portal_sales_orders_path
      expect(response).to have_http_status(:redirect)
      expect(flash[:alert]).to include("You are not authorized")
    end

    it "shows only orders belonging to the current sales user" do
      # Create an order for the current sales user
      order.update!(sales: sales_portal_user)

      # Create an order for another sales user with a known ID
      other_sales = create(:portal_user, :sales)
      other_order = create(:order, sales: other_sales)

      get portal_sales_orders_path

      expect(response).to have_http_status(:success)

      # Verify orders in the controller
      expect(assigns(:orders)).to include(order)

      # Only test the controller's assigned orders - more reliable than HTML parsing
      orders_from_controller = assigns(:orders)

      # Optional: If you want to verify the HTML as well

      # Look for the order ID with the specific data attribute
      order_id_element = html_doc.css("[data-test='order-id-#{order.id}']")
      expect(order_id_element).to be_present

      # The other order's ID should not be present with the specific data attribute
      other_order_id_element = html_doc.css("[data-test='order-id-#{other_order.id}']")
      expect(other_order_id_element).to be_empty
    end
  end

  describe "POST /portal/sales/orders" do
    let(:product) { create(:product) }
    let(:valid_params) do
      {
        package_id: product.id,
        total_msisdn: 5,
        customer_type: "corporate"
      }
    end

    it "creates a new order with correct attributes" do
      expect {
        post portal_sales_orders_path, params: valid_params
      }.to change(Order, :count).by(1)

      order = Order.last

      # Check order attributes
      expect(order.sales).to eq(sales_portal_user)
      expect(order.form_stage).to eq("customer_stage")
      expect(order.status).to eq("draft")

      # Check order item
      expect(order.order_items.count).to eq(1)
      expect(order.order_items.first.product).to eq(product)
      expect(order.order_items.first.item_quantity).to eq(5)

      # Check pricing
      expect(order.total_price).to eq(product.price * 5)
      if product.tax == "exclude"
        expect(order.tax_price).to be_within(0.01).of(order.total_price * 0.11)

        expect(order.tax_price).to eq(0)
      end

    end

    it "requires authentication" do
      sign_out sales_portal_user
      post portal_sales_orders_path, params: valid_params
      expect(response).to redirect_to(new_portal_user_session_path)
    end

      sign_in portal_user
      post portal_sales_orders_path, params: valid_params
      expect(response).to have_http_status(:redirect)
      expect(flash[:alert]).to include("You are not authorized")
    end

    context "when tracking GA events" do
      it "sets session tracking data" do
        post portal_sales_orders_path, params: valid_params

        expect(session[:track_order_creation]).to be true
        expect(session[:customer_type]).to eq("corporate")
        expect(response).to redirect_to(customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(Order.last))
      end

      it "clears session tracking data after redirect" do
        # First request should set the session
        post portal_sales_orders_path, params: valid_params

        # Verify session is set
        expect(session[:track_order_creation]).to be true
        expect(session[:customer_type]).to eq("corporate")

        # Follow redirect and check if session data is still there
        # (The session data should be consumed by the customer_stage action)
        expect(response).to redirect_to(customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(order))
      end

      # when redirecting to customer_stage, the session data should be consumed and cleared
      it "clears session data after visiting customer_stage" do
        post portal_sales_orders_path, params: valid_params
        order = Order.last

        # Simulate visiting the customer_stage page
        get customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(order)

        # After visiting, the session data should be cleared
        expect(session[:track_order_creation]).to be_nil
        expect(session[:customer_type]).to be_nil
      end
    end
  end

  describe "GET /portal/sales/orders/:id/sim_cards" do
    let!(:msisdn) { create(:msisdn, msisdn: "6281234567890") }
    let!(:iccid) { create(:iccid, iccid: "1234567890123456789") }
    let!(:postpaid_activation) do
      create(:postpaid_activation,
             order_item: order.order_items.first,
             msisdn: msisdn,
             iccid: iccid,

    end

    context "when sales user owns the order" do

        expect(response.body).to include("Detail SIM Card")
        expect(response.body).to include(order.order_reference_number)
        expect(response.body).to include(msisdn.msisdn)
        expect(response.body).to include(iccid.iccid)
        expect(response.body).to include("Child")
      end

      it "displays correct SIM card count" do
        get sim_cards_portal_sales_order_path(order)

        expect(assigns(:sim_cards).size).to eq(1)
        expect(assigns(:sim_cards).first[:msisdn]).to eq(msisdn.msisdn)
        expect(assigns(:sim_cards).first[:iccid]).to eq(iccid.iccid)
        expect(assigns(:sim_cards).first[:type]).to eq("child")
      end

      it "handles orders with multiple SIM cards" do

        msisdn2 = create(:msisdn, msisdn: "6281234567891")
        iccid2 = create(:iccid, iccid: "1234567890123456790")

class Admin::OrderItemsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_portal_user!
  before_action :authorize_admin
  before_action :set_order
  before_action :set_order_item, only: [ :show, :edit, :update, :destroy ]

  # GET /orders/:order_id/order_items
  def index
    @order_items = @order.order_items.includes(:product)
  end

  # GET /orders/:order_id/order_items/:id
  def show
  end

  # GET /orders/:order_id/order_items/new
  def new
    @order_item = @order.order_items.build
  end

  # GET /orders/:order_id/order_items/:id/edit
  def edit
  end

  # POST /orders/:order_id/order_items
  def create
    @order_item = @order.order_items.build(order_item_params)

    if @order_item.save
      redirect_to portal_admin_order_order_item_path(@order, @order_item), notice: "Order item was successfully created."
    else
      render :new
    end
  end

  # PATCH/PUT /orders/:order_id/order_items/:id
  def update
    if @order_item.update(order_item_params)
      redirect_to portal_admin_order_order_item_path(@order, @order_item), notice: "Order item was successfully updated."
    else
      render :edit
    end
  end

  # DELETE /orders/:order_id/order_items/:id
  def destroy
    @order_item.destroy
    redirect_to portal_admin_order_order_items_path(@order), notice: "Order item was successfully removed."
  end

  private
    # Use callbacks to share common setup or constraints between actions.
    def set_order
      @order = Order.find(params[:order_id])
    end

    def set_order_item
      @order_item = @order.order_items.find(params[:id])
    end

    # Only allow a list of trusted parameters through.
    def order_item_params
      params.require(:order_item).permit(
        :product_id,
        :price,
        :discount_price,
        :tax,
        :tax_price,
        :description
      )
    end
end

You are reviewing GitLab Merge Request #247 for the ide-phoenix Rails application.

## JIRA Context: ISB-2981
**Summary**: Edit Product order For Status order Draft (3)

**User Story**:
As a Sales representative, I want to edit product selections and quantities for orders in Draft status, so that I can correct or update orders before submission.

**Key Acceptance Criteria**:
1. Navigate back from MSISDN/ICCID page to order form with Edit button
2. Edit order details via main Edit button (customer info, addresses, notes)
3. Edit product items via pencil icon (opens modal with product dropdown, quantity input, price calculation)
4. Real-time price recalculation when product/quantity changes
5. Validate quantity: 1-10,000, integers only
6. Persist changes across page navigation

**Critical Technical Requirements**:
- Authorization: Only Sales/Admin can edit, only Draft orders editable (Pundit policy)
- Price auto-updates based on product pricing × quantity
- MSISDN allocation adjusts with quantity changes
- All changes must be audited via OrderAudit model
- No N+1 queries (verified with Bullet gem)
- Minimum 90% test coverage
- WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility
- CSRF protection and authentication required
- Optimistic locking for concurrent edits

module Sales
  class OrdersController < ApplicationController
    include ExceptionHandler
    include GaTrackable

    before_action :authenticate_portal_user!
    before_action :authorize_sales
    before_action :set_order, except: [ :create, :index ]

    def index
      @orders = current_portal_user.sales_orders
                     .exclude_customer_stage
                     .filter_and_sort(
                       query: params[:q],
                       status: params[:status],
                       sort_column: params[:sort],
                       sort_direction: params[:direction],
                       page: params[:page]
                     ).includes([ :sales, :location, :customer,
                               :akta_attachment, :npwp_attachment, :nib_attachment,
                               :ktp_owner_attachment, :ktp_pic_attachment,
                               :account_statement_attachment, :power_of_attorney_attachment,
                               :mou_attachment, { order_items: [ :product ] } ])
    end

    def create
      @submitted_data = {
        package_id: params[:package_id],
        total_msisdn: params[:total_msisdn],
        customer_type: params[:customer_type]
      }

      # > get product
      product = Product.find(@submitted_data[:package_id])

      # > create order model
      item_quantity = @submitted_data[:total_msisdn].to_i
      @order = Order.new
      @order.sales = current_portal_user
      @order.status = :draft
      @order.form_stage = :customer_stage
      @order.customer_data_approval = :pending

      @order.total_price = product.price * item_quantity
      @order.delivery_price = 0 # ! TODO: calculate delivery price
      @order.tax = product.tax
      @order.tax_price = product.tax == "exclude" ? (@order.total_price * 11 / 100) : 0
      @order.discount_price = 0 # ! TODO: calculate discount price
      @order.security_deposit = product.security_deposit # security deposit always use tax exclude (added 11% by system)

      # > create order item
      order_item = OrderItem.new(
        product: product,
        price: product.price,
        discount_price: 0,
        tax: product.tax,
        tax_price: product.tax == "exclude" ? (product.price * 11 / 100) : 0,
        description: product.description,
        item_quantity: item_quantity
      )
      @order.order_items << order_item

      @order.save!
      logger.info "Order Created: #{@order.inspect}"

      # Store tracking data in session for the next page (due to redirect)
      session[:track_order_creation] = true
      session[:customer_type] = @submitted_data[:customer_type]

      redirect_to customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order)
    end

    def sim_cards
      @order = current_portal_user.sales_orders
        .includes(order_items: { postpaid_activations: [ :msisdn, :iccid ] })
        .find_by(id: params[:id])

      unless @order
        redirect_to portal_sales_orders_path, alert: "Order tidak ditemukan."
        return
      end

      @sim_cards = []
      @order.order_items.each do |order_item|
        order_item.postpaid_activations.each do |activation|
          @sim_cards << {
            msisdn: activation.msisdn_number,
            iccid: activation.iccid_number,
            type: activation.parent? ? "parent" : "child"
          }
        end
      end
    end

    private
      def set_order
        @order = Order.find_by(id: params[:id])
        if @order.nil?
          redirect_to portal_sales_dashboard_path, alert: "Order not found"
        end
      end
  end
end

require 'rails_helper'

RSpec.describe "Sales Orders", type: :request do
  include_context "with order data"

  before do
    sign_in sales_portal_user
  end

  describe "GET /portal/sales/orders" do
    it "returns http success" do
      get portal_sales_orders_path
      expect(response).to have_http_status(:success)
    end

    it "redirects to login if not authenticated" do
      sign_out sales_portal_user
      get portal_sales_orders_path
      expect(response).to redirect_to(new_portal_user_session_path)
    end

    it "redirects with alert if user does not have sales role" do
      sign_in portal_user
      get portal_sales_orders_path
      expect(response).to have_http_status(:redirect)
      expect(flash[:alert]).to include("You are not authorized")
    end

    it "shows only orders belonging to the current sales user" do
      # Create an order for the current sales user
      order.update!(sales: sales_portal_user)

      # Create an order for another sales user with a known ID
      other_sales = create(:portal_user, :sales)
      other_order = create(:order, sales: other_sales)

      get portal_sales_orders_path

      expect(response).to have_http_status(:success)

      # Verify orders in the controller
      expect(assigns(:orders)).to include(order)
      expect(assigns(:orders)).not_to include(other_order)

      # Only test the controller's assigned orders - more reliable than HTML parsing
      orders_from_controller = assigns(:orders)
      expect(orders_from_controller).to include(order)
      expect(orders_from_controller).not_to include(other_order)

      # Optional: If you want to verify the HTML as well
      html_doc = Nokogiri::HTML(response.body)

      # Look for the order ID with the specific data attribute
      order_id_element = html_doc.css("[data-test='order-id-#{order.id}']")
      expect(order_id_element).to be_present

      # The other order's ID should not be present with the specific data attribute
      other_order_id_element = html_doc.css("[data-test='order-id-#{other_order.id}']")
      expect(other_order_id_element).to be_empty
    end
  end

  describe "POST /portal/sales/orders" do
    let(:product) { create(:product) }
    let(:valid_params) do
      {
        package_id: product.id,
        total_msisdn: 5,
        customer_type: "corporate"
      }
    end

    it "creates a new order with correct attributes" do
      expect {
        post portal_sales_orders_path, params: valid_params
      }.to change(Order, :count).by(1)

      order = Order.last

      # Check order attributes
      expect(order.sales).to eq(sales_portal_user)
      expect(order.form_stage).to eq("customer_stage")
      expect(order.status).to eq("draft")

      # Check order item
      expect(order.order_items.count).to eq(1)
      expect(order.order_items.first.product).to eq(product)
      expect(order.order_items.first.item_quantity).to eq(5)

      # Check pricing
      expect(order.total_price).to eq(product.price * 5)
      if product.tax == "exclude"
        expect(order.tax_price).to be_within(0.01).of(order.total_price * 0.11)
      else
        expect(order.tax_price).to eq(0)
      end

      # Check redirect
      expect(response).to redirect_to(customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(order))
    end

    it "requires authentication" do
      sign_out sales_portal_user
      post portal_sales_orders_path, params: valid_params
      expect(response).to redirect_to(new_portal_user_session_path)
    end

    it "requires sales role" do
      sign_in portal_user
      post portal_sales_orders_path, params: valid_params
      expect(response).to have_http_status(:redirect)
      expect(flash[:alert]).to include("You are not authorized")
    end

    context "when tracking GA events" do
      it "sets session tracking data" do
        post portal_sales_orders_path, params: valid_params

        expect(session[:track_order_creation]).to be true
        expect(session[:customer_type]).to eq("corporate")
        expect(response).to redirect_to(customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(Order.last))
      end

      it "clears session tracking data after redirect" do
        # First request should set the session
        post portal_sales_orders_path, params: valid_params
        order = Order.last

        # Verify session is set
        expect(session[:track_order_creation]).to be true
        expect(session[:customer_type]).to eq("corporate")

        # Follow redirect and check if session data is still there
        # (The session data should be consumed by the customer_stage action)
        expect(response).to redirect_to(customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(order))
      end

      # when redirecting to customer_stage, the session data should be consumed and cleared
      it "clears session data after visiting customer_stage" do
        post portal_sales_orders_path, params: valid_params
        order = Order.last

        # Simulate visiting the customer_stage page
        get customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(order)

        # After visiting, the session data should be cleared
        expect(session[:track_order_creation]).to be_nil
        expect(session[:customer_type]).to be_nil
      end
    end
  end

  describe "GET /portal/sales/orders/:id/sim_cards" do
    let!(:msisdn) { create(:msisdn, msisdn: "6281234567890") }
    let!(:iccid) { create(:iccid, iccid: "1234567890123456789") }
    let!(:postpaid_activation) do
      create(:postpaid_activation,
             order_item: order.order_items.first,
             msisdn: msisdn,
             iccid: iccid,
             status: :activated)
    end

    before do
      # Ensure the order belongs to the current sales user
      order.update!(sales: sales_portal_user)
    end

    context "when sales user owns the order" do
      it "shows SIM card details for the order" do
        get sim_cards_portal_sales_order_path(order)

        expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
        expect(response.body).to include("Detail SIM Card")
        expect(response.body).to include(order.order_reference_number)
        expect(response.body).to include(msisdn.msisdn)
        expect(response.body).to include(iccid.iccid)
        expect(response.body).to include("Child")
      end

      it "displays correct SIM card count" do
        get sim_cards_portal_sales_order_path(order)

        expect(assigns(:sim_cards).size).to eq(1)
        expect(assigns(:sim_cards).first[:msisdn]).to eq(msisdn.msisdn)
        expect(assigns(:sim_cards).first[:iccid]).to eq(iccid.iccid)
        expect(assigns(:sim_cards).first[:type]).to eq("child")
      end

      it "handles orders with multiple SIM cards" do
        # Create second SIM card
        msisdn2 = create(:msisdn, msisdn: "6281234567891")
        iccid2 = create(:iccid, iccid: "1234567890123456790")
        create(:postpaid_activation,
               order_item: order.order_items.first,
               msisdn: msisdn2,
               iccid: iccid2,
               status: :pending)

        get sim_cards_portal_sales_order_path(order)

        expect(assigns(:sim_cards).size).to eq(2)
        expect(response.body).to include(msisdn.msisdn)
        expect(response.body).to include(msisdn2.msisdn)
        expect(response.body).to include(iccid.iccid)
        expect(response.body).to include(iccid2.iccid)
      end

      it "shows empty message when no SIM cards exist" do
        postpaid_activation.destroy

        get sim_cards_portal_sales_order_path(order)

        expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
        expect(assigns(:sim_cards)).to be_empty
        expect(response.body).to include("Tidak ada data SIM card untuk order ini")
      end


      it "handles different SIM card statuses" do
        postpaid_activation.update!(status: :failed)

        get sim_cards_portal_sales_order_path(order)

        expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
        expect(assigns(:sim_cards).first[:type]).to eq("child")
        expect(response.body).to include("Child")
      end
    end

    context "when sales user doesn't own the order" do
      it "redirects with error message" do
        other_sales = create(:portal_user, :sales)
        order.update!(sales: other_sales)

        get sim_cards_portal_sales_order_path(order)

        expect(response).to redirect_to(portal_sales_orders_path)
        expect(flash[:alert]).to eq("Order tidak ditemukan.")
      end
    end

    context "when order doesn't exist" do
      it "redirects with error message" do
        get sim_cards_portal_sales_order_path(99999)

        expect(response).to redirect_to(portal_sales_dashboard_path)
        expect(flash[:alert]).to eq("Order not found")
      end
    end

    context "when user is not authenticated" do
      it "redirects to login" do
        sign_out sales_portal_user
        get sim_cards_portal_sales_order_path(order)
        expect(response).to redirect_to(new_portal_user_session_path)
      end
    end

    context "when user doesn't have sales role" do
      it "redirects with error message" do
        sign_in portal_user  # Non-sales user
        get sim_cards_portal_sales_order_path(order)
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:redirect)
        expect(flash[:alert]).to include("You are not authorized")
      end
    end
  end
end
